title: Gold certification
detail: “Save Me” was certified Gold by the Recording Industry of South Africa (RiSA) within months of its release.

title: South African Music Awards nominee
detail: “Save Me” was nominated for Record of the Year.

title: Signed to Universal Music South Africa
detail: Signed as a full artist after only a few months of releasing music.

title: Rage Festival
detail: Played to more than 20,000 festival-goers, eight months after his first DJ set.

title: ULTRA South Africa
detail: Has performed on the line-up of South Africa’s biggest dance music festival.
